answer: Each epoch the registry runs a census. Every identity files a thread of signed work and locks a 70-credit bond; each key gets one whisper, a fresh task only that key can answer in an hour, so no operator answers a thousand. A raven auditor replays each thread, burning the bond behind any copied or rented one. Fees climb per key: first 40, k-th 40+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 2,537,500 against a 40,000 pool. Honest ones pay 40 once, share intact.
